_note: Libraries copied into vendor/. deps_check.py hashes each file; when you update one, set the new version and sha256 here (sha256sum vendor/<file>).
_note_reviewed: An advisory may be listed here only when the installed version is proven not affected (a backported fix, or vulnerable code not reachable). It applies to that exact package version; any version change re-opens it.

reviewed_advisories.reason: OSV marks every version below 6.4.1 as affected, but 5.24.1 (latest-5 line) ships a rewritten DOM.sanitize(): an element/attribute allow list that iterates a snapshot from getAttributeNames(), so the live NamedNodeMap skip is gone. 6.x is ESM-only and would need the app to switch to ES modules.
